title: On Scanning the whole page in seconds
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：scan　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scan 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the father ① scanned the whole page in seconds in public, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② scans the whole page in seconds in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ scan the whole page in seconds at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ scanned the whole page in seconds before — a line in the letter for September 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Scanning the whole page in seconds in public, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ scan the room for a familiar face in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Scan the room for a familiar face at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ scans the room for a familiar face in public every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ scanned the whole page in seconds again when nobody else would.

⑩ To scan the whole page in seconds, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody scans the whole page in seconds in silence again and somebody must scan the whole page in seconds in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 扫描（一般过去式 scanned the whole page in seconds：1971 年父亲头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 扫描（一般现在 scans the whole page in seconds：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 扫描（不定式 to scan the whole page in seconds：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 扫描（过去完成时 had scanned the whole page in seconds：1965 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 扫描（动名词 scanning the whole page in seconds 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 扫视（scan the room for a familiar face：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去扫视在屋里扫寻一张熟面孔）
G. v. 扫视（scan the room for a familiar face：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 扫描（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 scans the room for a familiar face，而母亲又一次 scanned the whole page in seconds）

scan 意为“扫描”，自那以后父亲一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 scans。
scan 意为“扫描”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯扫描几秒钟就把整页扫完”，此处为不定式 to scan the whole page in seconds。
scan 意为“扫描”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1978 年之前就有人扫描过，故用过去完成时 had scanned。

scan 意为“扫视”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻扫视在屋里扫寻一张熟面孔（scan the room for a familiar face at once），以后再也不要提起。
scan 意为“扫描”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例扫视在屋里扫寻一张熟面孔，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 scans。
scan 意为“扫描”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面扫描几秒钟就把整页扫完，用一般过去式 scanned 叙述。
scan 意为“扫描”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要扫描几秒钟就把整页扫完，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 scan 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the father scanned the whole page in seconds in public, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father scans the whole page in seconds in silence whenever the house asks.
Scanning the whole page in seconds in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever scan the room for a familiar face in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house scans the room for a familiar face in public every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother scanned the whole page in seconds again, and the house remembered that half.
